defect: Porosity cluster at the bearing boss
description: Hairline crack at the bearing boss on the clamp side. The crack starts about 0.4 mm below the surface and does not follow the ejector-pin witness marks. Vacuum in the die cavity drifted from 118 to 221 mbar across the shift, and the batch was accepted on a 1.9 ppm hydrogen deviation (limit 1.4). The ejector pins were serviced two days ago and the marks are on the opposite face. A CT/loupe capture is attached, plus the sensor window and the batch record.
